product_overview: BetStake is a provably-fair online casino backend providing instant and session-based games, multi-currency wallets, auto-betting/strategy automation, and real-time multiplayer via Socket.IO. The API exposes authentication, betting, wallet, seed management, strategy CRUD, rakeback and health endpoints for frontend and workers.
core_goals: Provide secure JWT-based authentication and user profile access.
Process provably-fair bets across instant and session games with precise wallet updates.
Support automated betting (autobet) with user-defined strategies and background workers.
Expose seed management for provably-fair verification (client seed, server seed rotation).
Allow users to manage multi-currency wallets and claim rakeback.
Offer CRUD for user strategies and integrate strategy presets into autobet.
Maintain lightweight health check and auditability for verification and troubleshooting.

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Register new accounts, log in to receive a JWT token, and retrieve the current authenticated user profile (settings and stats).
user_flows: POST /api/auth/register with { username, email, password } -> Receive 200 with { token, user: { id, username, email, role } } -> GET /api/auth/me with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with user object including settings and stats
POST /api/auth/register with existing email -> Receive 400 validation error or user already exists

POST /api/auth/login with valid { email, password } -> Receive 200 with { token, user: { id, username, email, role, isVip, isPremium, level } } -> GET /api/auth/me with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 user profile
POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 Invalid credentials
GET /api/auth/me without Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Bet Engine
features.description: Place instant bets, start/stop autobet sessions, retrieve bet history or single bets, and verify bets via the provably-fair system.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/bet/place with Authorization: Bearer <token> and { gameType, currency, amount, gameParams } -> Receive 200 with { bet, result, wallet }
POST /api/bet/place with Authorization: Bearer <token> and { amount larger than available balance } -> Receive 400 validation or insufficient funds error

POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/bet/autobet/start with Authorization: Bearer <token> and { gameType, currency, amount, config } -> Receive 200 { success: true, message: 'Auto-bet started' } -> GET /api/bet/autobet/status with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 AutoBet status object -> POST /api/bet/autobet/stop with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 { success: true }
POST /api/bet/autobet/start with Authorization: Bearer <token> and invalid config (e.g., negative numberOfBets) -> Receive 400 Error message

POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/bet/history with Authorization: Bearer <token>?limit=10&offset=0 -> Receive 200 { bets: [...] } -> GET /api/bet/:betId (public) with specific bet id -> Receive 200 Bet object
POST /api/bet/verify with Authorization: Bearer <token> and { betId } -> Receive 200 verification result with match status
POST /api/bet/verify with Authorization: Bearer <token> and unknown betId -> Receive 400 Error message

features.name: Wallet Service
features.description: Retrieve user wallets (multi-currency), inspect a single currency wallet, and simulate deposits by adding balance (deposit simulation).
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/wallet with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 Wallet[] containing per-currency balances
POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/wallet/:currency with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 Wallet object for that currency
POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/wallet/add with Authorization: Bearer <token> and { currency: 'USD', amount: 100 } -> Receive 200 Updated wallet
POST /api/wallet/add with Authorization: Bearer <token> and { currency: 'USD', amount: -50 } -> Receive 400 Invalid amount

features.name: Provably Fair Seeds
features.description: Expose the user's active seed pair (serverSeedHash, clientSeed, nonce), allow updating the client seed, and rotate (reveal) the server seed pair to enable bet verification.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/seed/active with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 { serverSeedHash, clientSeed, nonce, revealed, hasActiveGame }

POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/seed/client-seed with Authorization: Bearer <token> and { clientSeed: 'myseed' } -> Receive 200 Updated seed pair info -> GET /api/seed/active with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Confirm clientSeed updated
POST /api/seed/client-seed with Authorization: Bearer <token> and empty clientSeed -> Receive 400 Validation error

POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/seed/rotate with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 { oldSeed: {...}, newSeed: {...} } -> Use oldSeed.serverSeed to locally verify prior bets

features.name: Strategy Engine
features.description: Retrieve preset and user strategies, create/update/delete custom strategies (owner-only), and fetch individual strategies by id.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/strategy/all with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 { strategies: Strategy[] }
GET /api/strategy/defaults (public) -> Receive 200 { strategies: Strategy[] }

POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/strategy with Authorization: Bearer <token> and { name, conditions } -> Receive 201 { strategy: Strategy } -> GET /api/strategy/:id with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 { strategy: Strategy }
PUT /api/strategy/:id with Authorization: Bearer <token> updating a strategy not owned by user -> Receive 403 Forbidden
DELETE /api/strategy/:id with Authorization: Bearer <token> deleting a non-existent or non-owned strategy -> Receive 404 Not found or cannot delete

features.name: Mines Game (Session-based)
features.description: Start a mines session (grid generation), reveal tiles (specific or random safe), cash out current multiplier, and clean up orphaned sessions.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/mines/start with Authorization: Bearer <token> and { minesCount, betAmount, currency, gridSize } -> Receive 200 { sessionId, gridSize, minesCount, currentMultiplier } -> POST /api/mines/reveal with Authorization: Bearer <token> and { sessionId, tileIndex } -> Receive 200 { safe, gameOver, currentMultiplier, revealedTiles } -> POST /api/mines/cashout with Authorization: Bearer <token> and { sessionId } -> Receive 200 { bet, payout, profit, multiplier, grid, wallet }
POST /api/mines/start with Authorization: Bearer <token> and betAmount exceeding balance -> Receive 400 Validation or insufficient funds error
POST /api/mines/reveal with Authorization: Bearer <token> and { sessionId, tileIndex } when tile is a mine -> Receive 200 { hitMine: true, grid, bet } indicating game over
POST /api/mines/reveal with Authorization: Bearer <token> and invalid sessionId -> Receive 400 Error

features.name: Tower Game (Session-based)
features.description: Start a tower session, reveal tiles per floor (hit/clear), and cash out the current session multiplier.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/tower/start with Authorization: Bearer <token> and { floors, betAmount, currency } -> Receive 200 { sessionId, floors, currentMultiplier } -> POST /api/tower/reveal with Authorization: Bearer <token> and { sessionId, tileIndex } -> Receive 200 { safe, currentFloor, currentMultiplier } -> POST /api/tower/cashout with Authorization: Bearer <token> and { sessionId } -> Receive 200 { bet, payout, profit, multiplier }
POST /api/tower/reveal with Authorization: Bearer <token> and { sessionId, tileIndex } hitting a bomb -> Receive 200 { hitBomb: true, grid }
POST /api/tower/start with Authorization: Bearer <token> and invalid floors parameter -> Receive 400 Validation error

features.name: Stairs Game (Session-based)
features.description: Start a stairs session, reveal a tile for the current step, and cash out session progress at any time.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/stairs/start with Authorization: Bearer <token> and { steps, betAmount, currency } -> Receive 200 Session info -> POST /api/stairs/reveal with Authorization: Bearer <token> and { sessionId, tileIndex } -> Receive 200 Step result -> POST /api/stairs/cashout with Authorization: Bearer <token> and { sessionId } -> Receive 200 Cashout result
POST /api/stairs/reveal with Authorization: Bearer <token> and invalid tileIndex -> Receive 400 Validation error or game error

features.name: HiLo Game (Session-based)
features.description: Start a Hi-Lo card session, make higher/lower/skip guesses against the next card, and cash out accumulated multiplier.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/hilo/start with Authorization: Bearer <token> and { betAmount, currency } -> Receive 200 { sessionId, currentCard, currentMultiplier } -> POST /api/hilo/guess with Authorization: Bearer <token> and { sessionId, guess: 'higher' } -> Receive 200 { correct, nextCard, currentMultiplier } -> POST /api/hilo/cashout with Authorization: Bearer <token> and { sessionId } -> Receive 200 Cashout result
POST /api/hilo/guess with Authorization: Bearer <token> and invalid guess value -> Receive 400 Validation error

features.name: Blackjack Game (Session-based)
features.description: Play a full blackjack hand: start a session (deal), then perform actions such as hit, stand, double, split, or insurance until resolution.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/blackjack/start with Authorization: Bearer <token> and { betAmount, currency } -> Receive 200 { sessionId, playerHand, dealerUpCard } -> POST /api/blackjack/hit with Authorization: Bearer <token> and { sessionId } -> Receive 200 Updated hand state -> POST /api/blackjack/stand with Authorization: Bearer <token> and { sessionId } -> Receive 200 Final result with dealer hand
POST /api/blackjack/double with Authorization: Bearer <token> and { sessionId } when user has insufficient balance for doubling -> Receive 400 Insufficient funds or validation error
POST /api/blackjack/split with Authorization: Bearer <token> and { sessionId } when split is not allowed (e.g., cards differ) -> Receive 400 Invalid action

features.name: Rakeback System
features.description: Opt in/out of rakeback, view status and unclaimed amounts, preview calculated rakeback, claim rakeback for a currency, and view claim history.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/rakeback/status with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 { optedIn: boolean, unclaimed: object } -> POST /api/rakeback/opt with Authorization: Bearer <token> and { optIn: true } -> Receive 200 Result object

POST /api/rakeback/claim with Authorization: Bearer <token> and { currency: 'USD' } -> Receive 200 Claim result -> GET /api/rakeback/history with Authorization: Bearer <token>?limit=20 -> Receive 200 History array
GET /api/rakeback/calculate/:currency with Authorization: Bearer <token>?period=weekly -> Receive 200 Calculation result
POST /api/rakeback/claim with Authorization: Bearer <token> and unsupported currency -> Receive 400 Error (invalid currency or nothing to claim)

features.name: Health Check
features.description: Lightweight endpoint to verify the server process is running and return a timestamp.
user_flows: GET /health -> Receive 200 { status: 'ok', timestamp: string }
POST /health -> Receive 404 Not Found (method not allowed on health endpoint)
